title: Island Match Quest
one_line: Flip shells, fruits, and gems to match pairs, clear three islands, and chase a high score.
how_to_play: Tap Play, then tap a card to flip it and tap another to find its match. A match stays face up and scores points; a miss flips both back. Clear every pair to unlock the next island. Each island has a move limit; run out and you get one second chance with extra moves. Fewer moves and a faster time earn a bigger bonus. Restart starts you over from Island 1 anytime.
description: A beginner-friendly memory matching game across three islands: Shell Shore, Fruit Grove, and Gem Cavern. One self-contained HTML file with no dependencies, built-in instructions, a live score, move counter, timer, and a restart button.
